FakeDirectorTextBefore1:
Y-you! You came to
rescue me?
FakeDirectorTextBefore2:
Is that what you
were expecting?

Wrong!
I'm an imposter!

I pretended to be
the real thing to

prepare for our
takeover.

Do you want to
know where we hid the real DIRECTOR?

Sure, I'll tell
you. But only if you can beat me!
FakeDirectorWinText:
OK, OK. I'll tell
you where he is.
FakeDirectorTextAfter:
We stashed the
real DIRECTOR in

the UNDERGROUND
WAREHOUSE.

It's at the far
end of the UNDER- GROUND.

But I doubt you'll
get that far.
Executivef1SeenText:
Remember me from
the HIDEOUT in MAHOGANY TOWN?

I lost then, but I
won't this time.
Executivef1BeatenText:
This can't be
happening!

I fought hard, but
I still lost…
Executivef1AfterBattleText:
{PLAYER}, isn't it?

A brat like you
won't appreciate

the magnificence
of TEAM ROCKET.

That's too bad.
I really admire your power.
RadioTower5FRocketBossBeforeText:
Oh? You managed to
get this far?

You must be quite
the trainer.

We intend to take
over this RADIO

STATION and an-
nounce our come- back.

That should bring
our boss GIOVANNI

back from his solo
training.

We are going to
regain our former glory.

I won't allow you
to interfere with our plans.
RadioTower5FRocketBossAfterText:
How could this be?

Our dreams have
come to naught.

I wasn't up to the
task after all.

Like GIOVANNI did
before me, I will

disband TEAM
ROCKET here today.

Farewell.
RadioTower5FDirectorThankYouText:
DIRECTOR: ,
thank you!

Your courageous
actions have saved

#MON nation-
wide.

I know it's not
much, but please take this.
RadioTower5FDirectorDescribeClearBellTex:
There used to be a
tower right here in GOLDENROD CITY.

But it was old and
creaky.

So we replaced it
with our RADIO TOWER.

We dug up that
bell during construction.

I heard that all
sorts of #MON

lived in GOLDENROD
in the past.

Perhaps…

That bell has some
connection to the

TIN TOWER in
ECRUTEAK CITY…

Ah!

That reminds me…

I overheard TEAM
ROCKET whispering.

Apparently, some-
thing is going on at the TIN TOWER.

I have no idea
what is happening,

but you might look
into it.

OK, I better go to
my OFFICE.
RadioTower5FDirectorText:
DIRECTOR: Hello,
!

You know, I love
#MON.

I built this RADIO
TOWER so I could

express my love
of #MON.

It would be nice
if people enjoyed our programs.
BenText:
BEN: Do you listen
to our music?
